title: Guest searches hostels near UCU, filters by price and opens a hostel page
expected: Explore lists live hostels near UCU Mukono without an account; a price filter narrows the list; the hostel page shows room types, prices and rooms left
actual: 8 hostels listed for UCU Mukono; 5 after a maximum price of UGX 700,000; Hillview Hostel page shows 3 room types with prices and rooms left

title: A new student signs up, confirms the university email, books a room and pays by mock mobile money
expected: Account created and confirmed by email link; booking confirmed only after the server verifies the payment; reference and receipt shown; rooms taken goes up by 1
actual: Account confirmed by email link; booking NST-72517 status "paid" after server verification; receipt shown; Hillview rooms taken 20 to 21

title: The owner sees the booking and fee; the custodian gives a room, records the balance and checks the student in
expected: Booking and fee appear on the owner Money page; custodian assigns a free bed of the booked type; check-in is possible only after the balance is recorded
actual: Owner Money page lists Brenda Achieng's fee; room B-02 given; "Check in" hidden until "Balance received"; booking status now "checked-in"

title: An admin approves a pending owner and their submitted listing; it goes live on Explore with a verified badge
expected: Owner status becomes approved; listing status becomes live and verified; the hostel appears on Explore
actual: Owner Daniel Okello approved; Namilyango Road Hostel status live and verified; its public page opens for a guest

title: A visitor scans the gate QR code and signs in; the custodian marks them as left
expected: Visitor sign-in form opens without an account; visit recorded with time in; custodian sees them inside and can mark them as left
actual: Visitor signed in from the QR page without an account; custodian saw them inside and marked them left (time out 14:29)

title: After a completed stay the student writes one review; a second review is not offered
expected: Rate your stay appears only for the completed booking; the review is saved and shows on the hostel page; the button disappears afterwards
actual: One review saved for booking NST-30840 (4 stars); "Rate your stay" no longer offered for it

title: A student who already has a booking this semester is refused a second one
expected: The booking dialog explains the one-booking-per-semester rule and offers "See my bookings"; no second booking is created
actual: Dialog "You already have a booking" shown with the rule and a link to bookings; bookings for this student stayed at 1

title: A wrong phone number is rejected, and a declined payment leaves nothing booked
expected: A short number shows a field error before any charge; a declined charge shows a clear message; no paid booking is created
actual: Short number refused: "Enter a mobile money number, like 0772 123 456 or +256 772 123 456."; declined charge: "The payment did not go through. You were not charged."; paid bookings stayed at 0

title: A custodian cannot open owner or admin pages, or read another hostel's bookings
expected: Owner and admin routes send the custodian back to their own pages; the database returns no rows for another hostel even when asked directly
actual: /o/money redirected to /c/today; /a/overview redirected to /c/today; direct query: 32 bookings at own hostel, 0 at another hostel, 0 owner payout rows

title: A student cancels within 48 hours; rooms left goes back up
expected: Cancel is offered during the 48-hour window; after confirming, the booking is cancelled and the room count returns
actual: Booked and paid (rooms taken 0 to 1); cancelled within the window; status "cancelled"; rooms taken back to 0
